== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The complete remastered paper slip and the separate issuer full card are two different witnesses. The gallery retains non-smuggler eligibility and does not print a deploy-phase phrase. Both reduce the opening forfeit bonus and the deploy discount and drop the Jabba’s Palace waiver. The gallery capture date gives no ordering between the two publisher renditions. The existing historical article and route retain their gallery wording.
